data.summary: Seasoned Program Manager and AI enthusiast with extensive experience leading enterprise AI-driven digital transformation programs across Asset & Wealth Management and Payments ecosystems. Expertise in delivering AI/ML analytics platforms, data modernization, and payment innovations including UPI, DCMS, ACS, and cross-border payments, ensuring compliance with RBI and NPCI regulatory frameworks. Experienced in managing end-to-end AI/ML, Agentic AI lifecycle delivery, Goverance including data engineering, Snowflake data platform migrations, AWS data lakes, advanced analytics, and ESG automation initiatives. Proven ability to translate business problems into AI-driven solutions, enabling improved risk analytics, operational efficiency, and customer insights. Led large-scale transformation initiatives at M2P Fintech, Fidelity International, and HSBC, delivering Salesforce CRM enhancements, cloud modernization, and scalable analytics platforms that accelerated time-to-market and reduced operational costs. Strong expertise in Agile and Waterfall program governance, stakeholder management, and cross- functional leadership, utilizing frameworks such as RAID, RACI, OKRs, and enterprise delivery governance to successfully deliver complex AI and fintech programs. Currently serving as Program Manager at M2P Fintech, with prior experience at Fidelity International, HSBC, Capita, Tech Mahindra, Capgemini, and Mphasis (HP Company) delivering transformation initiatives across financial services, telecom, and technology domains.

responsibilities: ( Working for one of the leading Indian Bank)
Led UPI program for top Indian bank, ensuring NPCI compliance and 99.99% uptime.
Led DCMS (Debit Card Management System ) delivery covering card issuance, lifecycle management, limits, controls, and integrations with core banking, ACS, and card networks
Led AI/GenAI-driven fraud detection and transaction intelligence models across UPI and card ecosystems.
Spearhead evaluation of LLM-based customer support automation and dispute resolution workflows using contextual transaction data.
Driven roadmap for AI-enabled payment analytics, leveraging transaction data for insights, anomaly detection, and personalization

ACS (Access Control Server): Program managing ACS for debit card authentication (3DS), ensuring RBI/NPCI and card-network compliance, secure transaction flows, certifications, and production stability.
Loyalty & Rewards: Program managing bank loyalty platform including earn-burn journeys, partner integrations, and customer engagement initiatives aligned with business and marketing goals.

. Led Snowflake( SAAS based Datawarehouse )migration for unified reporting system, generating predictive insights using AI/ ML models providing single source of truth increasing ROI , operational excellence and scalability.

. Led implementation of enterprise GenAI use cases using licensed ChatGPT (FIL GPT) ( GenAI) to automate fund commentary, factsheets, and investment report generation, reducing manual effort and improving turnaround time

. Spearhead Automation of ESG/ Sustainability Investment reporting (NFR) by replacing manually generated report from multiple sources in Excel/PDF with EUC and macros. Operational Readiness and Transitioning of ownership from one team to another.This automation reduces manual effort by 80% ease scalability , increase ROI and Time to Market.

WeeFin( 3rd party tool) for ESG Data Mastering , Portfolio aggregation and third-party vendor feeds. It's a integration of Weefin, FIL systems and direct external feeds from MSCI, MOODY'S etc. Reducing manual efforts. Increasing Scalability, ROI. Then integrating FILGpt ( GenAI) with snowflake for report gsneration.
Automated Salesforce-Medallia NPS surveys reducing manual effort by 90% resulting in increase in ROI.
Led UK, German PI and Global Digital wealth CRM Salesforce org enhancement improving Customer Relationship Management.

. Led Sales enablement platform that allows users to easily search and download l fund-related documents (e.g., factsheets, presentations, fund data, holdings, performance summaries, and Solvency II reports.

Automation of Client Onboarding Workflow using Appian and AWS to streamline onboarding for institutional mandates, integrating with Salesforce and centralizing data in AWS RDS (MySQL). Reduced manual processes, ensuring standardized, efficient client onboarding across regions.
. Led Client Reporting and Marketing Oracle Database Upgrade from Oracle 12c to 19c, impacting multiple ritical applications including Tableau, Salesforce, and Client Reporting apps.
. Led Sailpoint Integration for enterprise applications to streamline Identity Governance and enabled secured Democritization.
. Led the migration from Bamboo to Jenkins, cloud-based Jenkins, and Bitbucket to GitHub, optimizing the DevOps CI/CD pipeline and infrastructure

NSDL InstaDemat Integration wherein real-time Demat account opening capability developed via API integration between NSDL and HSBC NetBanking/Mobile platforms using ETB KYC, enhancing digital onboarding experience.
. Delivered UPI functionality for seamless fund routing, peer-to-peer transfers, and merchant payments, integrating multiple bank features into a single mobile platform.
. Led large-scale data migration of retail Demat customer Data from HSBC Core Banking to third-party vendor platform.

. Led development of Global Money Platform, HSBC’s cross-border payments initiative by supporting end-to-end development of the Global Money platform, enhancing international money transfer capabilities.

. Led implementation Locker Access Notification System, real-time SMS and Email alert system meet regulatory requirements for customer locker access notifications, improving compliance and customer communication.
. Delivered multiple FCA-directed projects; transitioned Applications and roles from UK to India.
. Implemented Agile & DevOps;.
. Managed distributed teams covering development, QA, UX, and support.
. Created Standard Operating Procedure for new Services.
. Delivered Carphone Warehouse telecom self-care portal (UK Greenfield).
. Implemented Agile Methodology and Devops.
. PCI DSS certification, ISO audits 9000 Recertification.
. Development of Big Data applications
. Led offshore transitions enhancement
implementation.
